frontmatter.name: audit-npm-dependencies
frontmatter.description: Audits npm dependencies (every package.json) for known CVEs, typosquatting, license risk. Read-only. Blocks on HIGH or CRITICAL findings.

frontmatter.name: audit-pom-dependencies
frontmatter.description: Audits Maven dependencies (every pom.xml) for known CVEs and policy violations. Read-only. Blocks workflow on HIGH or CRITICAL findings.

frontmatter.name: enforce-documentation
frontmatter.description: Verifies that every public Java class/method and every TS exported component/hook/function carries Javadoc / TSDoc. Read-only.

frontmatter.name: enforce-file-size-limit
frontmatter.description: Enforces the 100-line cap on every generated file. Read-only — reports files to split. Generated OpenAPI files are exempt.

frontmatter.name: generate-integration-test
frontmatter.description: Generates Testcontainers-based integration tests (Postgres, optional Ollama for Spring AI). Use when persistence or external systems are touched.

frontmatter.name: generate-jpa-entity
frontmatter.description: Generates a JPA entity plus its record DTOs (request/response), Spring Data repository and a pure mapper, on Java 25. Use when adding a new persistent aggregate.

frontmatter.name: generate-junit-test
frontmatter.description: Generates JUnit 5 + AssertJ + Mockito unit tests for newly generated backend code. Invoked automatically by backend-builder after every feature.

frontmatter.name: generate-react-hook
frontmatter.description: Generates a custom React 19 hook respecting the Rules of React, ≤100 lines, fully TSDoc'd. Use when extracting reusable stateful logic from a screen.

frontmatter.name: generate-react-screen
frontmatter.description: Generates a React 19.2 screen / page component with Compiler 1.0 enabled. No manual memoization, mandatory TSDoc, ≤100 lines, NO test file. Use when adding a new UI screen.

frontmatter.name: generate-rest-endpoint
frontmatter.description: Generates a Spring boot 4.0.7 REST controller with OpenAPI annotations, Bean Validation, RFC 7807 ProblemDetail error handling and pagination. Use when adding a new HTTP endpoint to an existing feature.

frontmatter.name: generate-spring-ai-feature
frontmatter.description: Generates a Spring AI 2.0.0-M6 feature on Spring boot 4.0.7 — ChatClient calls, Advisors, RAG with PgVector, structured output, tool/function calling. Use when the user asks for an AI capability (chat, summarisation, classification, agentic tools).

frontmatter.name: generate-spring-boot-module
frontmatter.description: Generates a self-contained Spring Boot feature module (controller + service + repository + DTO records + tests) on Java 25 / Spring boot 4.0.7. Use when adding a non-AI backend feature. Auto-splits files that would exceed 100 lines.

frontmatter.name: generate-typescript-types
frontmatter.description: Generates TypeScript types from the backend OpenAPI spec. Single source of truth — frontend never re-declares backend DTOs by hand. Use after any backend contract change.

frontmatter.name: manage-task-todo
frontmatter.description: Reads, writes and updates `.sylvain/todo.json`. Lets agents resume work after interruption and gives the user a clear view of progress. Use at the start, middle and end of every multi-step task.

frontmatter.name: progressive-build-verify
frontmatter.description: Compiles, lints and tests after each feature increment. Catches regressions early. Read-only on source — only runs commands.

frontmatter.name: provision-cloudflare-tunnel
frontmatter.description: Provisions a new Cloudflare Tunnel to expose an app (frontend or backend) publicly. Asks clarifying questions before acting — never assumes hostname, port or credentials location. Use when the user asks to expose a new app via Cloudflare or create a tunnel for it.

frontmatter.name: validate-java25-idioms
frontmatter.description: Validates that generated Java code uses Java 25 / Spring boot 4.0.7 idioms (May 2026). Read-only. Reports anti-patterns to fix.

frontmatter.name: validate-react19-idioms
frontmatter.description: Validates that generated React 19.2 / Compiler 1.0 code follows May 2026 idioms. Read-only. Reports anti-patterns to fix.

frontmatter.name: validate-springai-prompt
frontmatter.description: Caveman check that a prompt file fit Spring AI 2.0.0 template rules (StringTemplate {var}, brace vs JSON conflict, ghost vars, role split, structured output). Read-only — give report, fix only when asked.

frontmatter.name: architect
frontmatter.description: Designs structure, modules, packages and API contracts before any code is written. Owns scaffolding of new full-stack apps and OpenAPI-driven type generation.

frontmatter.name: cloudflare-tunnel
frontmatter.description: Exposes a new app publicly via a dedicated Cloudflare Tunnel. Always clarifies hostname, port and target repo before acting.

frontmatter.name: suggest-latest-stack
